name: field-inspection-packet
prompt: Prepare a professional on-site safety inspection packet for the Harbor Point facility. Use landscape Letter pages with 0.6-inch margins, a visible page border, two text columns separated by a rule, and line numbers every five lines. Add a repeating header with the facility name and inspection date, and a footer with Page X of Y. Include sections for Arrival Check, Equipment Review, Findings, and Emergency Response. Add a practical 5-column findings table, a short footnote that defines a critical finding, a bookmark named Emergency_Response on the emergency procedure, and a later cross-reference that directs inspectors back to it. Insert a next-page section break before the findings record so the packet has a clear printable division.
